instruction: Can you center the text layer horizontally? I need it to be perfectly centered on the canvas.

metadata.explanation: Task requires centering the text layer horizontally on the canvas. The evaluator finds the bounding box of the text and checks if its center is within 10% of the image's horizontal center.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies horizontal centering by finding text bounding box via pixel scanning and comparing center to image center
10% tolerance is appropriate for 'perfectly centered' requirement, accounting for pixel-level rounding
Postconfig properly exports image to PNG format for analysis
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (doesn't incorrectly access 'rules' key)
Complete coverage: single requirement (horizontal centering) is fully verified
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Logic assumes dark text (<128 gray) on light background (>128). Works for this task's orange_background.xcf but could add validation
Minor: If multiple dark elements exist, bounding box includes all. Task implies single text layer, so acceptable for this context
Minor: Edge case where no dark pixels exist (empty image) would cause text_center to be negative, though return value (0.0) would still be correct
